summary: The documents provide details about the Email Request Contact Change functionality. It includes ASP.NET controls used for the UI, JavaScript functions for validation, and C# methods handling email sending and attachment management.
purpose: To facilitate the request for changing contact information via an email interface, including handling attachments, validations, and user interface elements.

fields.name: txtEmailTo
fields.purpose: To receive the email address of the recipient.

fields.name: txtEmailBody
fields.purpose: To input the body of the email.

fields.name: cmdSend
fields.purpose: To send the email with specified details.

actors.name: User
actors.role: Initiates the request for a contact change via email.

actors.name: System
actors.role: Validates and processes the email request.

workflows.name: Email Request Contact Change
steps: User fills in the recipient's email, CC, and BCC fields.
User writes the email body and subject.
System sends the email if all validations succeed.
System handles any errors or warnings if validations fail.

business_rules: Email must have a valid recipient.
Attachments must be uploaded to a specific directory.
validations: Valid email format for recipient, CC, and BCC fields.
conditions: ShowBcc is determined by a query string parameter.
Email subject defaults if not specified.
system_behavior: Displays warnings and errors if validation fails.
Refreshes the page after sending the email.
dependencies: Linked to existing ASP.NET controls and C# classes in the system.
exceptions: Error messages displayed if email sending fails.
